data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Ghass-Sana', meaning 'to protect' or 'to guard'. In Islamic tradition, the name Ghusoon symbolizes the concept of divine protection and the role of a mother as a guardian and protector of her children. The name Ghusoon carries the meaning “Protection, Guardianship” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghusoon usually hope their child will grow to embody protection, guardianship and live with faith, good character and purpose.
